messages:
Evan: Quick note from support triage - post-launch customers asking for better rollout transparency. We have a mix of asks: per-tenant deploy tracking, rollback window visibility, and an easier opt-in for early access. Proposing: include a simple rollout & rollback timeline in post-launch followups.

Maya: Product thought: build a "deployment status" card in the Console that shows per-tenant status (deploying, canary, live, rolled back) + last 24h rollouts. Low-effort MVP: show only for Dedicated tenants. Estimated: 3 days (1 PM + 1 eng + 1 design).

Priya: This pairs well with our micro-iterations: when we do a canary, customers want to know who sees it. I'd prioritize this for Enterprise channels.

Evan: Proposed scope for 72h mini:
- P1: small Console card for Dedicated tenants showing current rollout state (owner: Maya)
- P2: Add rollout metadata to support CSV export (owner: Evan)
- P3: Short help doc + comms template (owner: Priya)

Maya: I'll wireframe and open a design ticket. Backend will be a simple flag in deployment metadata - can piggyback on release events.

ReleaseBot: ReleaseBot: FYI: deployment metadata available via internal API /internal/deploys. Can be throttled for Dedicated customers.

Evan: I'll collect example customer queries and support templates. Also adding an idea to surface rollback windows in the Console.

Priya: Decision: do this as a 3-day mini-scope after the streaming fixes. Move to backlog after current micro-iterations finish. Please ack and I'll create the epic.

Maya: Ack. Will start wireframes after current sprint.

Evan: Ack.

ReleaseBot: ReleaseBot: Noted. Adding tag: postlaunch/rollout-transparency
